questions.say: Good morning. My name is Alice, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your hometown. Where did you grow up?

questions.text: Is it expensive to live in your hometown?

questions.text: Has the population of your hometown changed recently?

questions.text: What is there for young people to do there?

questions.text: Are there any bridges in your town?

cueCard.topic: Describe a toy you liked when you were a child.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you liked this toy.

questions.text: Describe a toy you liked when you were a child.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a toy you liked when you were a child. You should say: what the toy was; who gave it to you; how you played with it; and explain why you liked this toy.

questions.text: Do you still have this toy?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you still have this toy?

questions.text: What can children learn from playing with toys?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a toy you liked when you were a child, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all toys and play. What can children learn from playing with toys?

questions.text: Are expensive toys better for children than cheap ones?
questions.say: Are expensive toys better for children than cheap ones?

questions.text: Should boys and girls play with the same kinds of toys?
questions.say: Should boys and girls play with the same kinds of toys?

questions.text: How have children's games changed since you were young?
questions.say: Now let's talk about play and technology. How have children's games changed since you were young?

questions.text: Is it better for children to play outside or with electronic games?
questions.say: Is it better for children to play outside or with electronic games?

questions.text: Do children today have less freedom to play outside than in the past?
questions.say: Do children today have less freedom to play outside than in the past?
